To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) TQM and HR practices are positively correlated, 2) the alignment of the quality orientation and the HR approach is positively correlated with the utilization of the human resource system, 3) the utilization of the system of HR practices and the alignment of the HR approach with the quality orientation have a positive effect of the organizational performance.
the alignment of quality and HRM orientation is statistically significant for HRM utilization, and that both TQM practices and HRM practices are positively associated with performance.
the implementation of a TQM system is positively associated with HRM practices and that both TQM practices and HRM practices are associated with organizational performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a specific type of organizational change: the adoption of total quality management.
the relationship of HRM and quality practices to organizational performance.
the following questions: (1) How does the HRM system affect organizational performance?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
TQM is not a single concept or practice but a collection of practices and concepts that can be used to improve organizational performance.
the implementation of HRM practices is positively associated to the performance of the organization.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the HRM practices and TQM practices are positively associated with organizational performance.
the HRM practices of a company are an important element in the implementation process of TQM.
the HRM practices and TQM have an impact on organizational performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance effects of HRM practices depend on the level of HRM system sophistication.
the HRM-TQM relationship is not straightforward, as it can be influenced by other factors.
the HR function can be more effective if the HRM system and the HR function are aligned with the business strategy.
